name: That Time of the Month
source:
"Spill their blood to spare you own."

That's what Briar does every month: turn into a werewolf & kills vampires as a somewhat unwilling hunter. All to avoid her periods.

But when the vampires up the ante by bringing out their queen, Briar realizes that maybe she's avoiding the monthly flow for reasons she never considered before. 

A fully voice-acted comedy visual novel about vampires hunting and queer awakenings. Oh, & periods. That too.

[From [url=https://storysinger-presents.itch.io/that-time]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“流他们的血，免得自己流血。”

布莱尔每个月都这么做：变成狼人，作为一名多少有些不情愿的猎手，猎杀吸血鬼。一切只为躲过月经。

然而，当吸血鬼派出女王，令局势升级时，布莱尔意识到：自己逃避每月流血的原因，或许是从未想过的另一回事。

一部全程配音的喜剧视觉小说，讲述猎杀吸血鬼与酷儿身份的觉醒。哦，还有月经。这个也包括在内。

[摘自[url=https://storysinger-presents.itch.io/that-time]itch.io[/url]]
